text:
You need a detailed Excel financial model that forecasts revenue, expenses, cash flow, CAC, user growth, and scenario outcomes for a scaling DeFi application.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, and data visualization. I focus on building models that are clear, decision-ready, and easy to update as assumptions change. For this project, I can structure a financial model that ties together acquisition channels, conversion rates, retention, advertising spend, and multiple revenue streams such as membership fees and transaction fees. I can also build sensitivity analyses so you can test how changes in key drivers affect projections, cash flow, and overall financial performance.

In a recent Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours, which reflects the kind of organized, reliable reporting approach I would bring to your model.

I also built a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners in Excel. It compared three sites using best, base, and worst case assumptions for patient volume and staffing, and the chosen site was projected to pay back in 14 months. That project required careful scenario planning and disciplined use of assumptions, which is directly relevant to building financial projections for a DeFi platform.

For your application, I would focus on building a clean Excel model with clearly separated inputs, calculations, and outputs. That would make it easier to adjust CAC assumptions, retention curves, and revenue drivers as your business evolves. I’m comfortable working with large datasets, cleaning and organizing data, and turning that information into useful financial analysis and dashboards. I can also help make the model readable for stakeholders who need to review assumptions, risk, and projected returns.

If you’d like, I can help you build a forecasting model that supports strategic planning, investment decisions, and scenario analysis for your DeFi application.
